minimalControlledReproductionIfAuthorize.base: Reuse passing isolated E unchanged except a dedicated dynamic viewport wrapper; same single scene, IDs/mode schedule, camera, environment, caption, no hands/nav/newhost. Start410 x70.285714 and shrink210 x36 at clear->active transition, then leave final size fixed through active->preview->active->preview. Preserve root/view identity; no remount or production modifier edits.
twoArms: Instant resize: apply identical size and initial selection transition with animation disabled at the owned probe boundary; record actual UIKit frame to verify no interpolated sizes.

Animated resize: identical inputs/timing but explicit easeInOut0.18 around that same transition; retain intermediate actual UIKit sizes and settled frame. A supplied SwiftUI target viewport is insufficient to classify animation.
interpretation: Instant passes/animated fails: narrows to animated resize/transaction interaction in isolated context; does not alone select a production fix.
Both fail: resize/initial selection coincidence is sufficient candidate independent of explicit animation.
Both pass: do not remove production animation on hypothesis; remaining difference includes actual parent layout/navigation/context.
If either fails, only then separate timing by completing the same resize while IDs remain empty and selecting after settlement; this distinguishes resize damage from material-change/resize overlap.
minimalControlledReproductionIfAuthorize.placement: First isolate size centered at a fixed center. Production additionally moves vertical position/changes center while scaling; if pure size arms pass, optionally add the measured placement change as a separate discriminator. Do not add size+translation+hand/nav changes together and call it a resize-only test.
minimalControlledReproductionIfAuthorize.evidence: Retain actual frame sequence and stable scene/root/camera identities, target viewport, requested/cached/material IDs/mode, and full settled screenshot at each subsequent phase. No claim from CPU RGBA alone; retain both directions and no hidden repeated scene recreation. Existing passing E is the fixed-size control.

limits: No runtime is launched here. Sparse samples cannot establish animation duration, exact layout proposal stack, or causal relation to stale pixels. Proposed arms are diagnostic preparation only.
